what: The vertical cut of WING IT! for examples/wing-it: film 82.0 s to 112.0 s in 12 shots, each with its own 9:16 crop. scripts/fetch-wing-assets.mjs reads this file and builds assets/wing_v.mp4 from it, so a change here changes the footage. start_s and end_s are film times; the cut points are the film's own cuts.

crop.x: x = floor(min(max(center_x * 1920 - 304, 0), 1312)), the left edge of a 608 px window centered on center_x (a fraction of the frame width)
crop.out: scaled to 1080x1920 with lanczos, 30 fps, sample aspect ratio 1

wide: A shot with center_x "wide" keeps the whole frame: it is scaled to 1080x608 (lanczos) and laid over a blurred, darkened copy of itself that is scaled to cover 1080x1920 (scale=-2:1920, crop=1080:1920, boxblur=20:2, eq=brightness=-0.12), at y 656, so the card sits in the middle of the frame.

shots.shows: the cat with his checklist, then yanked upside down
the dog in his orange suit, shouting
the rocket in the barn jolts and goes through the roof
the dog in the cockpit under G-force
the rocket climbs past the clouds and the moon
the red-lit cockpit, dog and cat
the cat from behind, reaching for the controls
a finger presses the parachute button
an umbrella opens over the hull and turns inside out
the hull throws out seven gadgets across the whole width of the frame, so it stays 16:9
the cockpit; a rooster comes through the windshield
